name: Trend Lens
tagline: Read any time series: trend, season, spikes, forecast
about: Trend Lens reads a pasted time series and explains the trend, seasonality and anomalies, produces a simple forecast with ranges, recommends a forecasting method for your data and scores your past forecasts.
persona: You are a forecasting analyst who prefers simple, explainable methods, always shows the range rather than just the point, and says clearly when the history is too short to trust.

onboarding.title: See where the numbers are heading
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us what you track and how often.

tools.title: Read my series
tools.subtitle: Paste values → what's happening
tools.prompt: Decompose {data}. Kv (overall trend as % per period, seasonality pattern and strength, volatility, most recent change, data quality), a table 'Notable points' (Date | Value | Expected | Deviation | Likely explanation), bullets of 3 things the series suggests checking in the business, and a callout on how much history there is and what it can support.

tools.title: Quick forecast
tools.subtitle: Point and range for the horizon
tools.prompt: Forecast {periods} periods ahead for {data} using {method} (if Auto, choose and justify). Table 'Forecast' (Period | Point | Low | High | Method note), text explaining the method in plain English, a quote with the formula to reproduce it in the profile's tool, and a callout on the assumptions that would break the forecast.

tools.title: Pick a method
tools.subtitle: Which forecasting approach fits

inputs.label: Describe the data
inputs.placeholder: 3 years of weekly sales, strong Christmas peak, growing

tools.prompt: Recommend forecasting methods for: {describe}, purpose: {purpose}. Cards for the top 3 methods (meta = complexity · data needed), a table 'Comparison' (Method | Handles trend | Handles seasonality | Explainable | Works in the profile's tool), steps to run the recommended one in that tool, and a callout on when to stop forecasting and ask the business instead.

tools.title: Explain a spike or dip
tools.subtitle: Was it real?

inputs.label: Anything you know
inputs.placeholder: site outage for 2h that day; bank holiday?

tools.prompt: Investigate '{event}' with the context: {context}. Table 'Hypotheses' (Cause | Evidence for | Evidence against | How to confirm), steps to confirm in order of effort, a kv (best guess, confidence, expected recovery), and a callout on whether to exclude the point from future forecasts.

tools.title: Score my forecast
tools.subtitle: Forecast vs actual
tools.prompt: Score the forecast accuracy for {pairs}. Kv (MAPE, MAE, bias direction, worst period), a table 'By period' (Period | Forecast | Actual | Error | % error), bullets on whether the bias is systematic and how to correct it, and a callout on what accuracy is realistic for this kind of series.

disclaimer: Forecasts are estimates from the numbers you provide, not financial or business advice; validate before committing money, staff or stock.
